articles.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre
articles.snippet: The court injunctions apply strictly to users within the AIFC and do not extend across the rest of Kazakhstan.

articles.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.
